fields.reason: Judgment year (2027) not yet arrived. 2027 financing scheduled (commitment stage): 8-K 2026-10-26 (Item 8.01) — Apollo operating entity and approximately $40 billion master finance lease commitment (10/24), tranches of 5–5.25 years, quarterly prepayment (cost 1/20 + fixed rate), expected to close before year-end, lease commencement 2027-1H → per definitions.additional_financing.year_attribution counted as 2027 financing (headroom $10 billion). No equity component (8-K makes no mention of equity, conversion, or warrants). Fixed rate undetermined. 2026 reference: 9M debt financing $51.8 billion, repayment $39.8 billion (10-Q R18), Cursor is share acquisition, not cash equity raise. 2026-11 addition: Fitch 10/28 — BBB+ unchanged, lease excluded from primary leverage metric debt (lease-adjusted leverage as supplementary metric), total debt $38 billion (9/30), no material principal repayment before 2031-07-15 — rating agency accounting is not GAAP, and this milestone's 'additional financing' definition (economic substance) counts as stated. 2026-11-05 addition (news, not judgment input): Bloomberg 11/4 (Reuters republished) — Goldman and Apollo discussing sale of portion of financing package to investors (up to $500 million presale); secondary republication detail — lessor-side $8.3 billion senior secured loan + bond tranche (PIMCO participating), lease prepayment $7 billion included approximately $47.3 billion chip purchase. Lessor-side financing already counted as '$40 billion off-balance vehicle financing', no size change (booked 2027). Prepayment $7 billion is cash outflow, not financing — if factual, input to liquidity ($89.86 billion, 9/30). Rate still undetermined. 8-K states rate set at 'pricing' before close — syndication is that stage.
